name: Ceylon Tea
where: Dilmah t-Lounge or Mlesna official shops
about: Ceylon tea is grown in Sri Lanka's hill country and is famous worldwide. Colombo is the island's main trading hub, so it is an easy place to buy good tea.
tip: Check that the label says Sri Lanka as the origin and shows the grade.

name: Cinnamon
where: Keells or Cargills Food City in the city
about: Sri Lanka is known for true cinnamon, which is milder and more delicate than the cassia sold in many other countries. It is a traditional spice of the island.
tip: Look for the name Cinnamomum verum on the package to confirm you are buying Ceylon cinnamon.

name: Batik Scarf
where: Laksala on York Street or in Thummulla
about: Laksala is the government-run craft shop, selling local handicrafts with fixed prices. Batik is a traditional hand-dyed fabric that is widely made in Sri Lanka.
tip: Compare silk and cotton fabrics, since the price and feel differ a lot.
